content: IRLS weights W_i = 1/[V(mu_i) * (deta/dmu)^2]. Working response z_i = eta_i + (y_i - mu_i) * g'(mu_i). Variance functions: Gaussian=1, Binomial=mu(1-mu), Poisson=mu, Gamma=mu^2. Canonical links: Gaussian=identity, Binomial=logit, Poisson=log, Gamma=reciprocal(1/mu). Canonical link means g'(mu) simplifies: Binomial g'=1/(mu*(1-mu)), Poisson g'=1/mu, Gamma g'=-1/mu^2, Gaussian g'=1. So IRLS weights for canonical links: Binomial w=mu(1-mu), Poisson w=mu, Gamma w=1/mu^2, Gaussian w=1.
